system.one_liner: Adds an explicit safety binary-classification task, read from a [CLS] token, to pretraining and SFT, with attention masks that keep next-token prediction intact.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a change of training format as aligned pairs: the token strip with labels, and the attention mask whose headers repeat the strip's colours, so that a special token visibly changes both the data layout and who attends to whom; redraw the same grid per phase so that only the changed cells differ.
lessons.suits: Papers that add a token, objective or mask to a transformer and must show data layout and attention constraints for several training phases.

the query tokens are not allowed to attend to the [CLS] token

summary: The paper makes safety alignment less superficial by adding an explicit safety classification task: a [CLS] token at the start of the sequence whose output goes through a classification head to label the input and the tokens generated so far as safe or unsafe. Figure 1 draws this in a 2 by 2 grid of dashed panels. The top row is pretraining, the bottom row SFT. On the left, a token strip shows input squares, label squares and positions 0 to 6, with the red CLS token feeding a 0/1 label and the other tokens feeding next-token labels; in SFT the queries carry no label and the answers are blue. On the right, 7 by 7 attention-mask grids with 0/1 cells and a legend show the causal area and the CLS attention area.
summary_zh: 论文在预训练和监督微调中加入显式的安全二分类任务：序列开头放一个 [CLS] 令牌。图 1 用 2×2 虚线面板，上排预训练、下排 SFT；左侧是输入与标签令牌条，右侧是 7×7 注意力掩码矩阵，展示因果区域和 CLS 注意区域。
notes: Prior kinds kept (model-anatomy / objective-graph, side-by-side-contrast); stage-pipeline with the phase-bands variant was considered because the rows are pretraining and SFT, but nothing is handed from one row to the other. The two attention matrices are placed as bitmaps in the SVG (digest: two bitmaps of about 60 by 60 pt), the rest is vector. The panel axis is entered as stages for all four panels although the columns are two views of one phase.
